title: Upstream fix in Next.js
body: Report the WebpackError issue to the Next.js team. The bug is in next@15.5.9's minify-webpack-plugin which uses webpack 5.98.0's compiled webpack bundle that no longer exports WebpackError. When Next.js releases a fix, remove the prebuild script and scripts/patch-next-minify-webpack.cjs.
rationale: The root cause is a regression in Next.js 15.5.9 that should be fixed upstream. Once fixed, the patch workaround should be removed.
